instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, the notebook goes on the pile of books, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
pile_center = pile["center"]
top_height = pile.get("top_height", pile.get("rim_height", 0.112))

# Find candidates for cyan_notebook
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_notebook")

# Look for edge pinch grasp candidate
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("edge_free_below") and c.get("reachable_checked"):
        chosen = c
        break

if not chosen:
    for c in candidates:
        if c.get("edge_free_below"):
            chosen = c
            break

if not chosen:
    for c in candidates:
        if c.get("reachable_checked"):
            chosen = c
            break

if not chosen and candidates:
    chosen = candidates[0]

approach = chosen["approach"]
finger_axis = chosen.get("finger_axis", [0, 0, 1])
gx, gy, gz = chosen["x"], chosen["y"], table_z + chosen["height"]

# Pre-grasp: 5 cm back along approach
pre_x = gx - 0.05 * approach[0]
pre_y = gy - 0.05 * approach[1]
pre_z = gz - 0.05 * approach[2]

open_gripper()
move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")
move_gripper(gx, gy, gz, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")
close_gripper()

# Lift straight up keeping orientation
lift_z = table_z + top_height + 0.15
move_gripper(gx, gy, lift_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

# Calculate offset between notebook center and grip point to center notebook on book_pile
nb_center = chosen.get("object_center", obs["objects"]["cyan_notebook"]["center"])
offset_x = gx - nb_center[0]
offset_y = gy - nb_center[1]

target_gx = pile_center[0] + offset_x
target_gy = pile_center[1] + offset_y

# Move horizontally over book_pile
move_gripper(target_gx, target_gy, lift_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

# Lower notebook onto book pile
target_place_z = table_z + top_height + chosen["height"] + 0.005
move_gripper(target_gx, target_gy, target_place_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

open_gripper()

# Retreat back along approach then lift
retreat_x = target_gx - 0.08 * approach[0]
retreat_y = target_gy - 0.08 * approach[1]
move_gripper(retreat_x, retreat_y, target_place_z + 0.02, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")
go_home()

        chosen = c
        break

            chosen = c

approach = chosen["approach"]
finger_axis = chosen.get("finger_axis", [0, 0, 1])
gx, gy, gz = chosen["x"], chosen["y"], table_z + chosen["height"]

# Open gripper and approach horizontally 5 cm back along approach
open_gripper()
standoff = 0.05
pre_x = gx - approach[0] * standoff
pre_y = gy - approach[1] * standoff
pre_z = gz - approach[2] * standoff

move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")
move_by(dx=approach[0] * standoff, dy=approach[1] * standoff, dz=approach[2] * standoff)
close_gripper()

# Lift well above obstacles and book pile (pile is ~0.112m tall, hand needs >0.11m clearance)
lift_z = table_z + 0.30
move_gripper(gx, gy, lift_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

# Move above book pile center, keeping orientation to maintain notebook level
target_zone = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
tx, ty = target_zone["center"][0], target_zone["center"][1]
# Note: candidate grip point is at an edge; to place notebook center over pile center,
# offset grip point relative to notebook center:
obj_c = chosen.get("object_center", [gx, gy])
offset_x = gx - obj_c[0]
offset_y = gy - obj_c[1]

target_grip_x = tx + offset_x
target_grip_y = ty + offset_y

move_gripper(target_grip_x, target_grip_y, lift_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

# Lower until contact onto book pile
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()

# Retreat along approach vector backwards to safely disengage the pinch grasp
move_by(dx=-approach[0] * standoff, dy=-approach[1] * standoff, dz=0.02)
retreat(0.12)
go_home()
check("cyan_notebook", "book_pile")
